accounts_type_fields.name: accounts_type_fields
accounts_type_fields.value:
("accounts"."type" = 'personal' and "accounts"."email" is not null and "accounts"."owner_account_id" is null)
        or ("accounts"."type" = 'robot' and "accounts"."owner_account_id" is not null)

grants_scope_chain.name: grants_scope_chain
grants_scope_chain.value: ("grants"."file_area_id" is null or "grants"."project_id" is not null) and ("grants"."folder_id" is null or "grants"."file_area_id" is not null)

hosted_agents_limits.name: hosted_agents_limits
hosted_agents_limits.value: "hosted_agents"."max_tokens" between 1000 and 2000000 and "hosted_agents"."max_tool_calls" between 1 and 200 and "hosted_agents"."max_duration_seconds" between 30 and 3600
